_comment: Official Cloudflare Free plan limits used by the Usage Monitor. Update this file when Cloudflare changes its limits. Nothing else in the code base hardcodes quotas.

workers.requests.note: Static asset requests are free and unlimited.

durableObjects.requests.note: Incoming WebSocket messages are billed 20:1; each WebSocket connection counts as one request.

durableObjects.durationGbSeconds.note: Billed as 128 MB per active (non-hibernated) object.

durableObjects.sqlRowsRead.note: Cloudflare pages disagree (5M vs 50M per day). The conservative value is used.

d1.storageGb.note: Each database is also capped at 500 MB on the Free plan.

d1.databaseStorageGb.note: Free plan cap of 500 MB per database; this is the one that applies in practice.

estimateCoefficients._comment: Conservative round-ups of the local measurements in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 9.1 (tests/e2e/game.e2e.mjs). Not Cloudflare-confirmed. Recalibrate after tests on a real account.

alertThresholds._comment: Percent of a quota. Administrators can lower or raise the first three in the Usage tab; 100 is fixed.

safeMode._comment: Reduced game for a day when a quota is close. Never enables paid features.
